assets.source: hand-pixeled (this project); 128px vector windmill rejected: isometric, does not match side-view scale
assets.notes: hub (sail pivot) = [21,25] from sprite top-left; verified by eye on the lit PNG. 84px tall tower; windmill is a backdrop/landmark, not a foreground house.

8 frames x 11.25deg = one 90deg cycle (4-fold symmetric). Put pivot [36,36] on windmill hub: sailsX = windmillX + (hub.x - anchor.x) = windmillX + 0, sailsY = windmillY - (anchor.y - hub.y) = windmillY - 58 (windmill anchor [21,83], hub [21,25]); sails origin = their pivot (0.5,0.5). Loop frames 0..7 at 6-10 fps.

sizeWarnings: Character is 32px cell (~28px figure). Tenement is 232px tall = 8.3x a person. Use it only as a backdrop/dormitory landmark (e.g. beyond the fence, x-parallax 0.9) and never in the street row.

A person is about door height in Autumn Town scale. Heights by chapter shape: tenement 232px, shop 183px, brick 172px, cottage 162px, hut 133px. Only the hut (133px) meets the <=135px foreground recommendation; cottage (162px) is borderline-large, brick (172px), shop (183px) and tenement (232px) are mid-ground/landmark only.

Landmark heights: council-hall 124px, debate-stage 145px, round-table-pavilion 94px, feynman-porch 91px, oral-exam-hut 77px, rubric-courthouse 101px, exam-oracle 131px, devils-ta-cave 97px, classroom-house 110px, panic-booth 60px, windmill 84px. exam-oracle (131px) and debate-stage (145px) are intentionally tall; flag if the street row feels crowded.
Windmill is 84px tall and only 42px wide: reads as a small silhouette; keep as backdrop landmark (hub-anchored sails 72x72 overhang the roof; check parallax clipping).
Trees: heights 50-74px; mid-scale dark trees are fine in props-back; they are shorter than the cottage/brick/shop houses.
Emotes (ui.emote-*) are native 16px Ninja Adventure art (2x coarser than 1x scene art) - keep at their native scale above heads; do not scale up.
Lamp posts: props 64px vs tall boulevard lamp 95px; the 95px one is taller than a hut door.

gaps.why: No ambient-creature sprites exist in composed/ (ninja-adventure-animal 16px is the wrong scale).
gaps.suggested approach: Hand-pixel a 3-4 frame cat (sit/walk) at ~14px tall, a 2-frame bird for the fence line, and use a 3x3 glow-core dot sprite as firefly particles (Phaser emitter, ADD blend).

gaps.why: Windows are baked into lit/dark house PNGs; no per-window frames exist.
gaps.suggested approach: Engine-side: overlay prop.window-lit decals with an alpha tween (0.85..1, random 600-1800 ms); meta window rects are stale, so re-measure first.
Phaser particle emitter with a 1x2 / 2x2 px white sprite drawn at runtime (palette cloud-hi); no art needed beyond that.
Palette-remap the van (roof-wine -> hill-far) with a new variant script; bus-stop sign optional.

gaps.need: Feynman freshman sitting on the porch
gaps.why: freshman has a generic sit pose but landmark.feynman-porch has no seat anchor (provenance has only a stale sign_slot).
gaps.suggested approach: Measure a seat point on the trimmed feynman_porch.png and place persona.freshman sit frames there; optionally add a porch-specific sit pose.

gaps.why: Only wall and moon bubble palettes exist.
gaps.suggested approach: Add a third bubble (alert-tinted outline) and matching tails for dissent speech; reuse the 9-slice recipe in props_ui.py.

gaps.why: No pixel dock icons. Lucide SVGs exist in assets/fluent-objects/icons (38, e.g. users, vote, lock, bus, mail).
gaps.suggested approach: Use Lucide SVGs in the DOM dock (phone) and tint to palette; optionally hand-pixel 16x16 versions for in-canvas use.
Not needed: tint/multiply in engine, or swap the sky variant only.

gaps.need: Interiors for debate stage, rubric courthouse, exam oracle, devil's TA cave
gaps.why: Only 4 interiors exist: study, classroom, council, oral exam.
gaps.suggested approach: Reuse interior.council for the courthouse and debate stage (stage props overlay), interior.oral-exam for the oracle; draw a dark cave interior (stalactite silhouette, glints) as a new 224x128 sheet.

gaps.why: Idle is 2 frames at 2 fps for every persona.
gaps.suggested approach: Acceptable for now; extend idle to 4 frames in make_characters.py if breathing needs more life.
Engine-side vertical-shear tween on prop.tuft-*; no new art needed.

gaps.why: Provenance meta is pre-trim and stale (flagged meta_coords_stale).
gaps.suggested approach: Re-run the building generators to export post-trim coordinates (door rect, chimney top, sign slot, seats) into provenance.json; until then do eyeball placement from PNG.

gaps.why: Art faces right only; no back or front views.
gaps.suggested approach: flipX for left; add front/back idle only if a scene needs it.

gaps.why: persona sit frames exist but bench/stool/stump have no seat anchors in provenance.
gaps.suggested approach: Use anchor bottom-centre of the prop plus a y offset of -4 px for the person and tune per prop.

gaps.need: Unlit twin for the tall lamp post
gaps.suggested approach: Palette-remap lit -> unlit or use prop.lamp-post.

gaps.why: Silkscreen/Jersey are TTF only for canvas text.
gaps.suggested approach: Use CSS @font-face and Phaser text, or hand-pixel a bitmap font if crispness at 3x becomes a problem.

notes.scale: All art at 1x. Game config: type AUTO, pixelArt true (roundPixels true), width 427 height 240 on desktop (zoom 3) and 195 x floor(h/2) on phone (zoom 2). Never scale sprites by non-integer factors.
notes.origin: originFrac is anchor/size; bottom-row anchors map to fy=1. Prefer sprite.setOrigin(...originFrac) and position at the ground contact (x, 240).
notes.atlasFacing: Characters face right; set flipX for left. Walk speed = 24 px/s at 8 fps (3 px per frame).
notes.parallax: For layers with scrollFactor<1 use this.add.tileSprite(0, 270, viewW, 270, key).setOrigin(0,1).setScrollFactor(0) and update tilePositionX = cam.scrollX * factor in update(); for factor 1 use plain images/tileSprite scrollFactor 1.
notes.nineslice: Phaser >= 3.60: this.add.nineslice(x, y, key, undefined, w, h, 5, 5, 5, 5) for bubbles (corner 5); corner 2 for withheld-bar.
notes.variants: Variant textures are loaded as '<id>:<variant>' (e.g. 'house.hut:dark'); swap with sprite.setTexture().
notes.animations: Spritesheet animations: this.anims.create({ key: id, frames: this.anims.generateFrameNumbers(id), frameRate: fps, repeat: -1 }). fps values are in the manifest `frame.fps`.
notes.blend: Light pools (fx.campfire-light, prop.lamp-halo) use blendMode ADD (or ordinary alpha 0.6); they contain no alpha ramp, only stepped dithered bands.

mismatches: assets/pixel/composed/ui/notes.png: provenance frame [9, 8] x2 is wrong for a 17x9 PNG; real layout is 2 frames of 8x9 separated by a 1px gap (manifest uses frame 8x9, spacing 1)
notes: atlas.json: 227 frames = 11 personas x (12 animation frames + 1 portrait); 212 animation frame refs, all inside the 672x480 atlas.
palette check ran on 275 distinct PNGs referenced by the manifest.
Two lamp posts exist: props/lamp-post(.lit) 24x64 and buildings/props/lamp_post_lit 23x95 (different heights, different folders); manifest keeps both with distinct ids.
1 building PNGs have transparent padding (bbox != full canvas): windmill_sails_strip.png

Building provenance doors/windows/sign_slot/chimney_x/seats/chair/glints/slit/chalkboard rects are pre-trim canvas coordinates; every building sprite PNG (sails strip excepted, see previous note) now has bbox == full canvas so they CANNOT be mapped back without the original trim offsets. Treated as stale and not published.
Windmill hub [21,25] checked by eye on windmill_lit.png: it lands on the wooden roof beam/hub block, so it is published (windmill meta is not part of the stale set).
Interior anchors (floor_y 112, seats, desks) are in an untrimmed 224x128 canvas and are published as-is; only size was cross-checked, positions were not visually verified.
